blocks.translation:
• Precautions for Use
• This product is made with precision. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product consists of precise electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, dirty it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in places that become very hot or very cold.
• Do not place this product on resin sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not forcefully pull or bend movable parts or mounting parts in directions they are not intended to move.
• Some pronunciations may have different intonation or may be difficult to hear due to the characteristics of the product; please understand this.
• Due to the nature of the product, there may be variations in appearance. Please be aware of this in advance.
• This product is certified as specified radio equipment under the Radio Law. A radio station license is not required to use this product.
• The radio frequency used (2.4 GHz) is also used by various devices (microwave ovens, wireless LAN devices, etc.), so radio interference may affect operation and performance. It cannot be used with two units simultaneously.
• Before using this product, please check the following. This product uses radio waves and has obtained the model certification permitted under Japan’s Radio Law, so installation approval procedures for high-frequency equipment are not required. (Model: XM9816Q) Please note that disassembling or modifying the product and thereby emitting unauthorized radio waves is a violation of the Radio Law and may be punished.

blocks.translation: ● This product is for Ages 15+.
